text: The wait is finally over. Blackwell is here and it's absolute monster.
zh: 等了这么久，老黄新核弹终于来啦！

text: We are talking about 200 teraflops of pure computing power in your palm.
zh: 这玩意儿放手里能跑二十万亿次！

text: But at what cost? $4,000 for a GPU? Nvidia has officially lost its mind.
zh: 老黄疯了吧？一张显卡卖四万？

text: Yet, every single AI lab on the planet is lining up to buy them.
zh: 全球AI实验室抢着买这玩意！

text: Is it the future of AI or just the biggest wealth transfer in history?
zh: 这玩意是AI未来还是史上最大韭菜局？
